basic_info.description: Beautifully Remodeled Pacific Ocean View Home.  Wonderful move-in ready home with spacious open floor plan, spectacular ocean views and a deluxe chef's kitchen with a family room that opens directly to the garden. Comfortable three-Level floor plan with one bedroom/bath on main level, a private master suite with walk-out view terrace with second bedroom on the upper level and great media/family room & two large bedrooms on lower level.  Lots of upgrades and amenities, sound system, hardwood floors, four gas fireplaces, high-end fixtures & finishes, two-car attached garage & prime St Francis Wood location. Convenient to West Portal Village, Muni, Bart & Highways 101/280.
